dependencies.node-fetch: Native fetch by default; vnode-fetch for Node agents, proxies, mTLS and compress:false
dependencies.uuid: Removed: native crypto.randomUUID for multipart boundaries

changes: Copy default/error state and use the complete VPM HTTP dependency tree.
Honor default limits, preserve falsy/byte-view request bodies and append query parameters before fragments.
Set multipart streams up lazily and validate part header values; preserve explicit Accept casing.
Settle streamed error bodies using vnode-fetch collection and propagate errors and limits.
Validate retry bounds, cancel backoff promptly, stop expired retry budgets and avoid replaying one-shot request streams.
Isolate proxy versus destination client certificates and key agent reuse by both key and certificate; provide explicit destroy().
Preserve RegExp noProxy state and handle wildcard/host-port bypass rules.
Retain upstream GaxiosError brand/version protocol for cross-package error recognition.
Encode native FormData with the runtime serializer instead of dropping its body.
Use the current Headers/URL/Response API, fetch wrapper, mergeHeaders and AIP-193 error causes.
Enforce redirect counts, cross-origin credential stripping, decompressed response limits and whole-attempt deadlines around native fetch.
Keep the original caller signal separate from per-attempt timeout signals and redact copied errors only after final retry.
Keep Node-readable data for default streamed responses; explicit custom fetch implementations retain their Web Stream data.
